d='/home/USER/runs/paper/glm-hpl0-u1-ceiling/frozen/held-out-reference-2/play/users/u052/system/state/workspace/programs'
os.makedirs(d,exist_ok=True)
src='''def transform(grid):
    H,W=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]
    from collections import deque
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if grid[i][j]!=8 and not seen[i][j]:
                cells=[];q=deque([(i,j)]);seen[i][j]=True
                while q:
                    r,c=q.popleft();cells.append((r,c))
                    for dr,dc in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        nr,nc=r+dr,c+dc
                        if 0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W and not seen[nr][nc] and grid[nr][nc]!=8:
                            seen[nr][nc]=True;q.append((nr,nc))
                rs=[r for r,c in cells];cs=[c for r,c in cells]
                colored=[(r,c) for r,c in cells if grid[r][c]!=0]
                crs=[r for r,c in colored];ccs=[c for r,c in colored]
                pr0,pr1,pc0,pc1=min(crs),max(crs),min(ccs),max(ccs)
                ph,pw=pr1-pr0+1,pc1-pc0+1
                pat=[[grid[pr0+a][pc0+b] for b in range(pw)] for a in range(ph)]
                for r,c in cells:
                    out[r][c]=pat[(r-pr0)%ph][(c-pc0)%pw]
    return out
'''
open(d+'/task-f9b4eeb8.py','w').write(src)
